title: Trauma History

groups.label: How the Patient Was Affected
choices: Learned about harm to a close person
Repeated exposure through work or caregiving

groups.label: Current Effects Attributed by the Patient
choices: Feeling on guard or easily startled
Feeling disconnected or losing track of the present

groups.label: Current Safety Concerns Reported
choices: Unwanted contact with a person associated with harm
Safety concerns in home or relationships
Safety concerns at work, school or in community
Immediate safety concern identified for clinician follow-up

groups.label: Discussion / Treatment Preferences
choices: Wants to discuss further with clinician
Requests explanation before questions or procedures
Interested in coping or stabilization skills

notes.context_notes: Optional Context / Approximate Timing / Other Information

instructions: Record only information the patient chooses to share. Check all applicable items; selections may concern different experiences or periods. Leave unassessed groups blank. A detailed account is not required.
limitations: Original history documentation fields, not a scored or validated trauma assessment. Selections do not establish a diagnosis, verify an event or replace a clinician’s safety assessment.
